observation: After the tmpfs ownership correction, Postgres started but the isolation verifier looked for Compose tmpfs entries in Docker's ordinary Mounts array. Docker records these entries in HostConfig.Tmpfs.
affected_invariant: Runtime isolation assertions must inspect the engine field that actually carries the tmpfs contract and must fail closed when it is absent.
correction: The verifier now requires /var/lib/postgresql/data in HostConfig.Tmpfs, preserves the ordinary Mounts projection separately, and records every tmpfs destination in the service manifest.
